schema.title: Response List Boards Api V1 Boards Get

post.description: Create a board (with Todo / In Progress / Done by default).

patch.description: Update a board's name or repo_url.

delete.description: Delete a board together with its cards.

get.description: Get the board screen: stages in order, each with its cards.

schema.title: Response List Members Api V1 Boards  Board Id  Members Get

post.description: Add a member to a board.

get.description: List a board's stages in position order.

schema.title: Response List Stages Api V1 Boards  Board Id  Stages Get

post.description: Add a stage to a board.

delete.description: Delete an empty stage (409 if it still has cards).

schema.title: Response List Milestones Api V1 Boards  Board Id  Milestones Get

post.description: Add a milestone to a board.

get.description: List a board's cards; filter by stage, assignee, milestone, or text (q).

schema.title: Response List Cards Api V1 Boards  Board Id  Cards Get

post.description: Create a card. Names or ids both work for stage, assignee, and milestone.

patch.description: Update a card. Send null for assignee_id or milestone_id to clear them.

delete.description: Delete a card and its comments.

post.description: Move a card to a stage (by name or id), optionally at a position.

get.description: List a card's comments, oldest first.

schema.title: Response List Comments Api V1 Cards  Card Id  Comments Get

post.description: Add a comment to a card.

get.description:
Report API and database status.

Returns:
    ``{"status": "ok", "database": "ok"}`` when the database answers.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 503 when ``select 1`` fails.
